newsitem.title: UK: UK refers Priory bid for Charter to MMC.
newsitem.headline: UK refers Priory bid for Charter to MMC.

text.p: Britain's Department of Trade and Industry said on Monday it would refer Priory Hospitals Group Ltd's planned buy of Charter Medical of England Ltd to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
Priory is owned by Britain's Mercury Asset Management Group Plc, while Charter is part of U.S. group Magellan Health Services Inc.

The DTI said Margaret Beckett, the new president of the Board of Trade, believed the proposed acquisition raised competition concerns related to the market for private in-patient psychiatric care in the London area.
The MMC were required to make a report by September 15 on whether the merger would be against the public interest, the DTI said in a statement.
In March, Magellan said it agreed to sell its two pyschiatric hospitals in London and another in Nyon, Switzerland, to Priory Hospitals. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
